reviews.title: Used to be….
reviews.text: I used to play this game daily and I still play 1-2 levels most days. Why the slack off? No way to earn money or tools beyond the 10 free daily coins and single bomb. I used to be able to watch typical ads for a few wheel spins every day and do the same with the gift box. I’m close to level 1200 but it has now been MONTHS since any of the ad-based rewards worked. There are levels that can’t be won without a tool. I can’t believe I’m asking for ads but guess what? I’m NEVER GOING TO BUY COINS. Guess I need a different game.

reviews.title: Game is basically good
reviews.text: I like the game but often the challenges are not just exiting the blocks; moving them smoothly & judging which is a movable block or a stationary part of the game board, can be frustrating. Some levels the whole board had the look of wood blocks but some are barriers & i kept trying to move them. But i do like that the ads between levels are relatively short & boosters are generously given. I don't have a clue what the coins are for. To spin the wheel & get coins rather than a booster feels more like punishment than a reward. What can one do with coins? Anyone got a clue?

reviews.title: Dangerous link embedded
reviews.text:
Great game but I was going to delete it because there’s no way to mute the annoying music/sound.
But then when I reached level 40 the same dangerous link appeared that made me delete Block Escape. The link “click to continue” leads to a phishing website & freezes your browser, cannot be closed, have to reboot.
Get rid of dangerous links & provide a way to mute sounds!
